title: Barnard-Steinerberger autocorrelation constant C_1c, lower bound
statement: A non-negative step function f = sum_i w_i 1_[i/K,(i+1)/K) with n > K integer weights gives C_1c >= K min_{0<=k<=K} A_k / S^2, A_k = sum_i w_i w_{i+k}, S = sum_i w_i. Find weights making this larger.
submission: JSON {"K": K, "weights_int": [...]}: non-negative integer weights, more of them than K.
